notes: Tested: a custom auth config created without `oauth_redirect_uri` sends `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add`. Register exactly the URI your auth config sends, or set `oauth_redirect_uri` to `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` and register that instead.
Composio does not provide a default shared OAuth app for Spotify; you must supply your own Client ID and Client Secret.

assumption: An agent that reads playback state, controls music, and manages user data in any customer's Spotify account

verdict.headline: Spotify requires an explicit business entity with 250k+ MAUs for production app review, and limits development apps to 5 test users.
verdict.summary: You can register a development app instantly in the Spotify Developer Dashboard, but you are strictly capped at 5 test users and require a Spotify Premium subscription. Moving to production requires filing for Extended Quota Mode, which is restricted to established business entities with active, launched services boasting at least 250,000 monthly active users.

handsOnEffort.label: 1–2 hours
handsOnEffort.basis: Creating a developer app and configuring redirect URIs takes minimal time.

timeToFirstConnection.label: Instant
timeToFirstConnection.basis: Self-serve registration allows testing immediately with your own account.

timeToProduction.label: 3–6 weeks
timeToProduction.basis: Extended Quota Mode review and approval requires a corporate review process taking up to 6 weeks.

verdict.longestPole: Meeting Spotify's strict Extended Quota Mode prerequisites (250k+ MAUs) and clearing corporate review.
verdict.costDetail: App owner requires an active Spotify Premium subscription for development mode access.

easierPaths.condition: Limit integration to 5 pre-approved test users
easierPaths.effect: Stays in Development Mode without requiring Extended Quota Mode approval.

factors.detail: Developers can instantly create a Client ID in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Production scale requires an Extended Quota Mode review.
Extended Quota Mode applications require an established business entity.
No formal independent security audit or penetration test is explicitly mandated beyond standard platform guidelines.
App owner requires a Spotify Premium subscription.
Production Extended Quota Mode is restricted to services with at least 250k monthly active users.
Development mode limits each app to a maximum of 5 authorized test users.
Standard OAuth authorization flow handles user authentication without manual per-customer tenant provisioning.

phases.title: Register your Spotify App
phases.outcome: You have a Spotify Developer account and a Client ID/Secret.

steps.title: Log in to the Spotify Developer Dashboard
steps.details: Go to the [Spotify Developer Dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard) and log in using your Spotify account. Ensure your account has an active Spotify Premium subscription, which is required for development access.
steps.agentAssist: An agent cannot log in for you due to authentication walls.

steps.title: Create a new application
steps.details: Click **Create App** in the dashboard. Enter your **App name**, **App description**, and provide your redirect URIs.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can draft your app name, description, and redirect URIs.

phases.title: Configure Redirect URIs and Scopes
phases.outcome: Your Spotify app is configured with Composio callback URLs and required scopes.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URIs
steps.details: In your app dashboard, go to **Settings** and add `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add` (or `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback`) to your **Redirect URIs** list. Click **Save**.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can generate the exact URI strings needed for Composio integration.

steps.title: Note Client ID and Client Secret
steps.details: Retrieve your **Client ID** and **Client Secret** from the app dashboard settings to use when registering the app in Composio.

phases.title: Test with your own account
phases.outcome: You have verified OAuth flow in Development Mode with up to 5 test users.

steps.title: Add test users
steps.details: In your app dashboard, navigate to **Users and Access** and add the Spotify user accounts you want to test with. Development mode is capped at 5 authorized users.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can compile a list of test user emails for you to add.

steps.title: Execute test OAuth flow
steps.details: Trigger the authorization code flow with PKCE against `https://accounts.spotify.com/authorize` using your test client ID and verify token issuance at `https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token`.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can script and execute the OAuth handshake test.

phases.title: Prepare for review
phases.outcome: Application materials, business verification, and scope justifications are ready for Extended Quota Mode.

steps.title: Verify business entity prerequisites
steps.details: Ensure your service is an established business entity with a launched product and at least 250,000 Monthly Active Users (MAUs), which is mandatory for Extended Quota Mode.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can draft proof-of-concept metric summaries and business details.

phases.title: Review and wait
phases.outcome: Spotify reviews and approves your Extended Quota Mode application.

steps.title: Submit Extended Quota application
steps.details: Submit your Extended Quota Mode request through the Spotify Developer Dashboard form. Provide comprehensive details on your service, user base, and required scopes.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can write application responses and map out scope justifications.

phases.title: Go live in Composio
phases.outcome: Your Spotify toolkit is fully wired into Composio and ready for production or test use.

steps.title: Create custom OAuth app in Composio
steps.details: Use the Composio API or CLI to create a custom OAuth2 auth config for the `spotify` toolkit, passing your `CLIENT_ID` and `CLIENT_SECRET`.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can execute the API call to configure your custom auth credentials.

requirements.detail: Required to access the Spotify Developer Dashboard and register a Client ID.
App owner must have a Spotify Premium subscription to use development mode API features.
Up to 5 test users must be explicitly added to the app's allowlist in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Extended Quota Mode requires an established business with at least 250,000 monthly active users.

scopes.purpose: Read access to user's subscription details and country.
Read access to user's email address.
Remote control playback of Spotify on a client.
Control playback and stream music through the SDK.
Control playback on the user's Spotify account.
Read access to the user's current playback state.
Read access to what is currently playing on the user's Spotify.

blockers.title: Exceeding Test User Limit in Development Mode
blockers.symptom: Users outside your allowlist receive an error when attempting to authenticate in Development Mode.
blockers.howToProceed: Add the user's Spotify account email to the allowlist under **Users and Access** in your Spotify Developer Dashboard (capped at 5 users), or apply for Extended Quota Mode.

blockers.title: Missing Premium Subscription on App Owner Account
blockers.symptom: API calls or development features fail or are restricted with errors regarding account tier.
blockers.howToProceed: Upgrade the Spotify account that created the developer app to an active Spotify Premium subscription.

blockers.title: Extended Quota Mode Rejection due to MAU Thresholds
blockers.symptom: Quota extension request is denied because the service does not meet the 250k MAU requirement.
blockers.howToProceed: Grow your service's user metrics to meet Spotify's criteria before reapplying, or keep usage confined to the 5 test users in Development Mode.

nuances.title: Token Lifetimes and Refresh Expiration
nuances.detail: Spotify access tokens expire in 1 hour. Refresh tokens expire after 6 months from initial authorization, or sooner if unused or explicitly revoked by the user.

nuances.title: PKCE Requirement
nuances.detail: Spotify supports and encourages Authorization Code Flow with PKCE (S256 hashing method) for enhanced security across all client types.

nuances.title: AI Model Training Prohibition
nuances.detail: Spotify Developer Terms and Guidelines strictly prohibit using Web API data to train machine learning models or AI generative models.

steps: Navigate to the Composio dashboard or use the Composio API to set up a custom auth configuration for the `spotify` toolkit.
Input your Spotify `CLIENT_ID` and `CLIENT_SECRET` obtained from the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Verify that the default scopes (`user-read-private user-read-email app-remote-control streaming user-modify-playback-state user-read-playback-state user-read-currently-playing`) are configured.
Pass your custom auth configuration ID to your Composio connection session.
